components.css: .ds-dialog{display:grid;gap:16px;max-width:512px;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#d6dfda);border-radius:12px;background:var(--background,#f7f8f7);color:var(--foreground,#182824);font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / .1),0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / .1)}.ds-dialog h2{margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:28px}.ds-dialog p{margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;color:var(--color-muted-foreground,#53645d)}.ds-dialog-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}.ds-dialog-actions button{height:36px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid var(--color-border,#d6dfda);border-radius:6px;font:500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:all 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-dialog-cancel{background:var(--background,#f7f8f7);color:var(--foreground,#182824);box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05)}.ds-dialog-cancel:hover{background:var(--color-accent,#e9efec)}.ds-dialog-actions .ds-dialog-delete{background:var(--color-destructive,#ae2929);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}.ds-dialog-delete:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-destructive,#ae2929) 90%,transparent)}.ds-dialog-actions button:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--primary,#186352);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary,#186352) 50%,transparent)}.ds-dialog-actions .ds-dialog-delete:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--color-destructive,#ae2929) 20%,transparent)}@media(max-width:639px){.ds-dialog{text-align:center}.ds-dialog-actions{flex-direction:column-reverse}}

narrative.overview:
MailPulse is a quiet task interface for routine work. Offwhite page backgrounds, white working surfaces and restrained teal actions keep attention on forms, records and their state. Its system typography is an explicit product choice, used for headings as well as body text.

The visual language is compact, readable and literal. Borders organize data; spacing separates tasks. Status and uncertainty remain visible in ordinary text. There are no promotional graphics or decorative dashboard summaries.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet offwhite and white surfaces with one teal action accent.
System sans typography; monospace reserved for tracking URLs.
Small rounded controls, bordered data regions and restrained depth.
Visible keyboard focus, pending, error, empty and copied states.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Use teal for primary actions, the brand, instructional disclosure and success feedback; keep data and supporting text neutral.

rules.name: The Working Type Rule
rules.body: Use the system sans stack for interface text and headings. Reserve monospace for tracking URLs and tabular numerals for counts and timestamps.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Let borders and white-on-offwhite layering organize the page. Reserve the larger shadow and dimmed backdrop for confirmation dialogs.

dos: Do preserve the single-column login form and direct task hierarchy.
Do keep the data table horizontally scrollable within its own region on narrow screens.
Do use visible labels, keyboard focus and explicit text for pending, empty, error and copied states.
Do pair destructive actions with clear wording and the confirmation dialog.
donts: Don't add marketing illustrations, promotional graphics or summary cards to these task surfaces.
Don't introduce a separate display font or ornamental type treatment.
Don't hide uncertainty behind a positive-colored metric or visual claim of a confirmed human open.
Don't shrink table text or collapse its columns to force a narrow viewport fit.
